name: ACNP 65th Annual Meeting 2027
description: The 65th ACNP Annual Meeting runs Sunday through Wednesday, January 10 to 13, 2027, at the Manchester Grand Hyatt in San Diego. Attendance is by membership or invitation, and poster abstract submission requires prior meeting registration.

deadlines.label: Travel award application
deadlines.note: 5:00 pm Central; notifications by late July 2026; closed

deadlines.label: Poster abstract submission
deadlines.note: 5:00 pm Central; not extended; notifications October 2026; closed

deadlines.label: Early registration
deadlines.note: registration opened June 2026; no early deadline published on the pages reviewed

sources.note: Dates January 10 to 13, 2027, Manchester Grand Hyatt San Diego, invitation cap, poster submissions open with registration in June
Poster deadline August 27, 2026; panel deadlines May 19, June 2, June 4, 2026; Promising Targets deadline October 28, 2026
Future meeting list including 2027 San Diego and 2028 Bahamas; 2026 meeting January 12 to 15 in Nassau

notes: ACNP moved from December to January meetings starting with the 64th meeting (January 2026), so there was no calendar 2025 meeting and the 2026 edition has already ended. Poster and panel deadlines for the January 2027 meeting have passed; only the Promising Targets track remains open.
